title: Cross-regional radiomics: a novel framework for relationship-based feature extraction with validation in Parkinson's disease motor subtyping.
summary: T1 MRI from 140 early-stage Parkinson patients is assessed across six classifiers and five-fold validation; motor-circuit features improve subtype discrimination. Published in BioData Mining.
ai_technology: Cross-regional radiomics extracts brain-network relationships to classify Parkinson motor subtypes.
organization: Department of Medical Radiation Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University, Tehran, Iran

evidence.tested: Limited early-stage cohort and no broad external-site validation restrict generalization.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: Cross-regional radiomics extracts brain-network relationships to classify Parkinson motor subtypes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
